data.location: 4359 Town Center Blvd., Suite 110, El Dorado Hills, CA 95762
data.short_description: A late-night, 21-and-older bar from owners Nick Dedier and Alexa Hazelton is planning to open in El Dorado Hills Town Center as soon as March 2027. It will take over the former Barrel and Bliss space and serve raw and cold items, charcuterie and bar food.

data.location: 4359 Town Center Blvd., Suite 110, El Dorado Hills, CA 95762
data.short_description: Barrel and Bliss, a wine bar, closed permanently earlier this month. The Double Standard will take over its space.

data.location: 4246 SE Belmont St., Suite 2, Portland, OR 97215
data.short_description: A new Japanese restaurant with a matcha cafe is planning to open on SE Belmont, aiming for January or February 2027. It will serve ramen, yakitori and Japanese desserts and have 49 indoor seats.
A permit filed with TDLR shows a new Big City Wings planned at The Grand at 249. The estimated $932,629 construction is set to start in mid-December and wrap up a little after mid-March 2027.
Bobby Anderson is bringing back the Magnolia's concept as Magnolia's Cafe in Conway, serving plated "meat-and-three" food. The cafe will have country décor and seats for about 80 guests.
Developer Steve Ghidella closed Magnolia's at 26th, a longstanding Myrtle Beach area restaurant, after buying it from the Anderson family. The concept is returning as Magnolia's Cafe in Conway.

data.location: Main and Washington Streets (Washington Square Office Building), 1126 Washington St, Columbia, SC 29201
data.status: no opening date has been made public yet
data.short_description: The Kessler Collection plans a Grand Bohemian Hotel in Columbia, described as the city's first four-star luxury hotel, in the redeveloped Washington Square buildings. It will include a spa, ballroom, art gallery, restaurants and an annual Christmas Market.
Franchisee Wei Zhu is bringing a second Jacksonville Paris Baguette bakery café to Bartram Commons, with seating for 45. Building construction is expected to finish early in 2027.

data.location: 7201B Iron Horse Xing SW, Aiken, SC 29803
data.short_description: New York Butcher Shoppe is preparing to open an Aiken location, according to the brand's website. The shop sells Certified Angus Beef, house-made sausages, seafood, prepared foods and wine.

The historic Kearny Mesa restaurant reopened under new owners Philanzo King, Michelle King and Garrick Charlton after an August acquisition. Friday nightlife events and weekend champagne brunches have returned.
The restaurant quietly closed in early July and stayed closed for four months before reopening under new ownership.

data.status: plans to bring its third location
data.short_description: Italian-American cocktail bar Bar Enzo, founded by Joe Schinco of Terzo Group, plans a third NYC location in Gramercy, according to business filings. No other details about the location have been announced.

data.location: 2295 S. Ridgewood Ave., South Daytona, FL 32119
data.short_description: DBPR records dated November 22, 2026 list a TORTILLA HOUSE restaurant project, with ARG MEX GROUP LLC as the applicant. The application is in plan review, and an opening date has not been confirmed.
Jimmy John's has a proposed sandwich shop on Radio Road that is moving through permitting. An opening date has not been announced.

ROJI, a Japanese-inspired night kitchen from Wave Sushi founder Jonathan McKinney, will take over the former Foxtail Coffee and Kelly's Homemade Ice Cream space. It will offer ramen, shareable plates, sake cocktails and a Japanese bodega.

data.location: Avion Park Westshore, 5308 Avion Park Dr, Tampa, FL 33607
data.short_description: Brazilian steakhouse Fogo de Chão is preparing to open a ground-up restaurant at the Avion Park Westshore mixed-use development. The news was first reported by the Tampa Bay Business Journal.

Texas Roadhouse will open in the former Carrabba's Italian Grill space, replacing the existing building with a new one. Upper Moreland Township commissioners approved a land development waiver 7-0 in June, and no opening timeline has been announced.

data.location: 9390 6 Mile Cypress Pkwy., Suite 4, Fort Myers, FL 33966
data.status: grand opening is expected sometime in December
data.short_description: Plan review documents show a new 16 Handles frozen yogurt shop in the Cypress Woods Shopping Center. A company representative confirmed a grand opening is expected in December.

data.status: plans for a new 16 Handles to open
data.short_description: What Now earlier reported plans for a new 16 Handles in Sarasota opening next year.

Chef Eric Leveillee's first solo restaurant will open in Kensington with 55 seats, a U-shaped chef's counter, a bar and a vinyl listening room. It will offer a 7- to 10-course tasting menu and an à la carte menu.

data.location: Largo Public Library, 120 Central Park Dr, Largo, FL 33771
data.short_description: Nature's Table, a healthy food franchise owned by Fast Fresh Brands, is opening a location inside the Largo Public Library. It serves toasted sandwiches, smoothies and custom drinks.
What Now Orlando reported in August on a Nature's Table Express in the works on South Park Center Blvd. It would serve only people with access to the building.
Float Dirty Soda is preparing to open a vintage-inspired soda shop with handcrafted dirty sodas and local ice cream. An opening date has not been confirmed.

A Korean barbecue restaurant with imported table-side grills is preparing to launch in a former meat market in downtown Donaldsonville. It will also serve stews, stir-fried dishes, banchan and lunch boxes.
A Korean-inspired sister café is preparing to open in a former law office around the corner from Gangnam Korean BBQ. It will offer a bulgogi panini, shaved ice desserts and specialty lattes.

data.status: will shut its doors after the New Year's celebration
data.short_description: House Wine, a retail wine shop and bar, is closing after nearly 20 years because the owner decided not to renew the lease. It will stay open through the holiday season.

data.status: set to close; "final day of operation on Sunday, December 20"
data.short_description: Kokomo, a Caribbean restaurant in Brooklyn founded in 2020 by Ria and Kevol Graham, is preparing to close permanently after 6 years. Its final day of operation is December 20, and it will hold farewell events like Friendsgiving and Girl Dinner before then. The owners did not give a reason for the closure.

data.status: closing permanently; "will officially close its doors after serving the community on Sunday"
data.short_description: LuLu's Express, a family-owned Maryland-style seafood and Southern soul food restaurant in West Charlotte, is closing. Its final weekend of service runs November 27–29. Owner Joseph "Jay" Davis said staffing frustrations led to the decision.

data.location: 5293-D Prospect Road, San Jose, CA 95129 (Westgate Center)
data.short_description: Vitality Bowls, a health-food café brand, celebrated the opening of its newest San Jose location at Westgate Center. It is the brand's 31st location in California. The menu includes açaí bowls, smoothies, wraps, salads and cold-pressed juices.

data.location: 5655 Centennial Center Blvd., Suite 170, Las Vegas, NV 89149
data.short_description: CAVA, a Mediterranean fast-casual brand, opened its first Nevada restaurant in Las Vegas. The restaurant has a Mediterranean-inspired dining room and digital order pickup. CAVA held three days of Community Day events with free meals and matched donations for the Las Vegas Rescue Mission.

data.location: 5030 W. University Drive, Suite 800, Prosper, TX 75078 (Westfork Crossing)
data.short_description: Public filings show Ulta Beauty plans a new store at Westfork Crossing in Prosper. Filings list an interior remodel and build-out, with construction expected from March 2027 to May 2027; these dates do not set an opening date. The filings don't say whether it will replace the existing store at 1031 S. Preston Road.

data.status: aiming for late 2027; opening depends on city permits
data.footage_size: building roughly 1,100 square feet (about 700 square feet consumption area); outdoor patio of about 150 square feet
data.short_description: All About Wellness Sacramento Dispensary is planning a cannabis consumption lounge in a separate building next to its Midtown shop, under the city's pilot program. Co-owner Philip Blurton said the opening depends on when the city issues permits. Only dispensary customers would be allowed into the lounge.

data.location: 1722 S. Coast Highway, Suite 104, Oceanside, CA 92054
data.status: expects to open the new location in December
data.short_description: FlowCorps is opening its second North County studio in South Oceanside. Founder Nicole Cannon confirmed a December target. The brand offers group workouts that combine Pilates with strength and cardio, and it already has a studio in Carlsbad.

data.location: 561 Spears Creek Church Road, Columbia, SC 29229
data.status: No opening date has been set yet; plans filed again
data.short_description: Plans for Tommy's Express Car Wash were filed again after the 2024 approval expired. Franchisee Olympus Pines Management Co., LLC submitted them, and they went before the City of Columbia Planning Commission on August 13. No opening date has been set.
A real estate listing says a new Wawa will open at 5990 GA Highway 21 in Port Wentworth. Mayor Tracy Saunders confirmed this location in March. It is part of Wawa's Georgia expansion.
Port Wentworth's mayor confirmed a second planned Wawa on Augusta Avenue. It would anchor the residential section near Publix. No date was given.

data.location: 1300 1st Avenue North, St. Petersburg, FL 33705 (Halcyon building, EDGE District)
data.footage_size: Not specified (two full floors of an 11-story office building)
data.short_description: Venture X, a coworking franchise, plans its first St. Petersburg location in the EDGE District. It will take two full floors of Halcyon, a planned 11-story office building. Franchisee Kevin Priddy runs 13 Venture X locations.

data.location: 1986 Freedom Blvd., Watsonville, CA 95019 (former Big Lots)
data.status: coming soon, with no confirmed opening date
data.short_description: Crunch Fitness franchisee Fitness Ventures LLC plans a $5 million Crunch 3.0 gym in a former Big Lots in Watsonville. It is the franchisee's fourth California location and 77th nationwide. The original announcement projected a Winter 2025 debut, but the location page still says coming soon.

data.status: planned; opening date not yet announced
data.short_description: A TDLR filing shows a new childcare facility for Candi's Creative Learning in Lancaster, with an estimated cost of $2 million. Construction is scheduled from December 1, 2026 to May 14, 2027. No opening date has been announced.
N/A

data.location: 4515 Beckwith Road, Mt. Juliet, TN 37122 (Golden Bear Place)
data.short_description: Wawa is expected to open in Mt. Juliet in Q1 2027 as part of the Golden Bear Place mixed-use development. The development will combine hospitality, entertainment and residential uses. The timeline may change.

data.status: preparing to open; set to open next year
data.short_description: Two Putt, an indoor mini golf course and sports bar, will take one of three ground-floor retail spaces in a new mixed-use development on the Concord River. Timothy Hajjar of Colomba Brothers came up with the idea. The development will also have 20 luxury apartments.

Brelundi, a local Sicilian restaurant founded by Michael Colomba, will occupy one ground-floor unit in the new 279 Boston Road development. The image caption says the businesses are set to open next year.
An unnamed brewery is set to open in the middle ground-floor space of the new mixed-use development.

data.status: will be open before the end of November
data.short_description: The Tampa Bay Business Journal reports that both EōS Fitness locations in Bradenton will open before the end of November.
EōS Fitness plans a Hernando County debut, with a location opening in Brooksville next year.
A second Hernando County EōS Fitness location is planned for Spring Hill in 2028.
EōS Fitness plans a Dunedin location as one of four Tampa Bay openings in 2027. The gyms offer strength and cardio equipment, pools, basketball courts and saunas.
EōS Fitness plans a Brandon location in 2027 as part of its Tampa Bay expansion.

data.location: 17631 N Dale Mabry Hwy., Lutz, FL 33548
data.short_description: EōS Fitness plans a Lutz location in 2027 as part of its Tampa Bay expansion.

data.location: 6900 US Hwy 19 N, Pinellas Park, FL
data.short_description: EōS Fitness plans a Pinellas Park location in 2027 as part of its Tampa Bay expansion.

ColorPop Workshop, a children's art studio founded by Tiffany Rafii and Sarah Terzic, will open in Tribeca between Desbrosses and Watts streets. Practicing artists lead classes for ages 3 to 12. The brand already has studios on Madison Avenue, Lexington Avenue and in Southampton.

data.status: slated to open in late March 2027
data.short_description: Glowbar, a membership-based facial studio chain, is preparing to open in South Boston, and a company representative confirmed it. The brand offers 30-minute facials by licensed estheticians and has nearly 30 East Coast studios. Membership costs $75 per month.

data.location: 153 E. Dublin Granville Road, New Albany, OH 43054
data.status: will open its brick-and-mortar boutique in December
data.short_description: RENOUVEAU Luxury Consignment, founded by Vicki Commeans, is preparing to open a luxury resale boutique in New Albany. It will sell pre-owned and select new designer handbags, clothing and vintage pieces. The name is French for revival and renewal.

Avant Garden Food Hall, a vegan food hall owned by Steve Donnelly, plans to open in Fair Oaks in January 2027 and roll out in stages. Local chefs and food makers will share the space and rotate through. Early partners include Pure Soul and Cultured Kitchen.
